canonical_title: Fast rope insertion and extraction systems service life
subject_group: 8.11 Fast rope insertion and extraction systems

versions.title_at_revision: Fast rope insertion and extraction systems service life
versions.text:
Standard: The FRIES (e.g., attaching hardware, quick release, and structural systems and their attachment to air vehicle) has positive durability margins to maintain residual strength throughout the specified service life. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct a loads analysis to define the usage spectrum used to determine the FRIES fatigue life.
(2) Conduct fatigue analysis on the FRIES using the usage spectrum developed in Analysis MoC (1) to verify durability capability to support loading throughout the specified service life. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct laboratory testing on the FRIES components to verify service life or component life limits.
